title: Nights into Dreams... (Demo)
overview:
In search of true courage, NiGHTS - and you yourself - take to the sky!

A new-sensation flight action game that pursues the joy of flying, set in a world of dreams, delivering exhilarating, dynamic excitement!

This disc is a demo version of NiGHTS into Dreams. Two children, Claris and Elliot, drift into Nightopia, the world where dreams are played out, as the evil Wizeman gathers power to rule it. They join forces with NiGHTS, a jester who has turned against him.

As NiGHTS, you soar along looping courses through the sky, spinning, performing acrobatics and drawing loops around enemies and items. Collect blue chips to break open the Ideya Captures and return the stolen Ideyas to the Ideya Palace before time runs out, then face the nightmare boss waiting at the end of each dream. Link rings into chains to push your score higher.

真の勇気を求めて、ナイツが、あなた自身が、空を飛ぶ！

空を飛ぶ楽しさを追求した、新感覚フライトアクションが、夢の世界を舞台に、爽快、ダイナミックな感動を演出！
